entries.appliesTo: Utah Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy (Department of Commerce); private parties only as voluntary participants in regulatory mitigation / joint interpretation agreements

params.program: AI learning laboratory + regulatory mitigation and joint interpretation agreements

sources.program: § 13-72-301(1) — 'There is established the Artificial Intelligence Learning Laboratory Program, to be administered by the office.'; § 13-72-401(2) — 'The office may grant, on a temporary basis, regulatory mitigation to a participant by entering into a regulatory mitigation agreement or a joint interpretation agreement'

flags: All binding duties fall on the state office (administer program, rulemaking, annual report to Business and Labor Interim Committee before November 30 per § 13-72-201(3)(d), regular audits of participants per § 13-72-401(6)); no mandatory company compliance duty is created

Participant obligations (consumer disclosures, reporting, safeguards) arise only through voluntarily executed agreements and office rules (§ 13-72-201(3)(c), § 13-72-401(4)), not directly from the statute
No penalty created; § 13-72-401(8)(b) preserves 'all applicable civil and criminal penalties' under existing law for violating participants — no exposure coded
Demonstration period capped at 12 months (§ 13-72-403(1)) with up to two 12-month extensions (§ 13-72-403(4)) — no matching param in the public-sector vocabulary
Repeals former § 13-72-304 (learning laboratory participation) and removes the application-based participation scheme
